title: xyz9 project config
description: Project config object: git seed under projects/, then living as KV secret and/or root output.config. Contributions accumulate under roots (by state_key) and projects (by projectName).

name.description: Project name; 3–8 alphanumeric characters; usually matches the filename stem

owner_group.description: Entra security group display name for the project owners, e.g. azhubs-owners

roots.description: Same-project root-module contributions keyed by state_key; empty in the git seed

hub_location.description: Hub location code from `catalog/projects/azhubs.json`, hubs key. Only set this for projects that land on a connected hub.

hubs.description: Hubs keyed by hub code. Only set on the azhubs project seed.

offices.description: Office sites that join the hub IPsec mesh, keyed by office code. Set on the azhubs project seed.

name.description: Human name of the office, e.g. stratusplein 1

network.description: Prefixes this office advertises and its router DNS label.

address_space.description: IPv4/IPv6 prefixes advertised as IPsec traffic selectors

router.description: Router DNS label (e.g. egx). IKE identity is {router}.{dns_domain}; peers reach it at {router}-ipv4.{dns_domain}

applications.description: Applications hosted at this office, keyed by application name.

docker.description: OPI Docker host, services, secrets, and backup policy for this office.

azure.description: Azure subscription, project resource group, and private DNS zones. Set on the azhubs project seed.

name.description: Project resource group name, e.g. rg-azhubs

location.description: Azure region for the project resource group, e.g. CentralIndia

subscription_id.description: Subscription this project is deployed into. azurerm provider subscription_id. Role assignment scope is /subscriptions/<subscription_id>.

private_dns_zones.description: Private DNS zone names created in the project resource group

projects.description: Cross-project contributions keyed by contributing projectName; empty in the git seed

devops.description: Azure DevOps project identity and permission policy. git_acls are named Git ACL maps; permission_sets bind a built-in project group plus Git selectors to those maps; role_permission_sets bind scope roles to permission set names. Git selectors: all = project-level (current and future repos); own.<kind> = repos of that kind whose dataset_key matches the role (e.g. own.adf → nyt.adf for dataset-nyt-engineer).

owner.description: Catalog project whose owner principal administers this Azure DevOps project. That project is applied first. Absent means this project administers its own.

current_name.description: Live Azure DevOps project name to adopt when it still differs from name

id.description: Devops project id when already created

git_acls.description: Named Git ACL maps. Values are Azure DevOps Git permission bits: Allow, Deny, or NotSet.

permission_sets.description: Named permission sets. project_group is a built-in Azure DevOps project group. git maps selectors (all, own.<kind>) to git_acls names.

role_permission_sets.description: Maps scope kind (platform, dataset) and role name to a permission_sets key. Bindings are by role, not per dataset instance.
